_readme: SONORA music manifest — HOW TO ADD MUSIC:
2) Add ONE object below to the 'tracks' array
3) Commit + push — no code editing needed.
Fields: id (unique slug), file (relative path), title, artist, album are required;
year, genre, duration, cover are optional.
If 'cover' is missing (or its file 404s) the app reads the ID3 tags embedded
in the mp3 instead (title / artist / album / cover art) via js/id3.js.
Strict JSON: no // comments — keep notes in keys starting with '_'.
The two entries below are working examples pointing at bundled demo audio,
so they play immediately — replace or delete them.
